title: No Text Needed: Forecasting MT Quality and Inequity from Fertility and Metadata

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting machine translation quality (ChrF scores) using linguistic metadata (resource availability/Joshi class, language family, and script) and token fertility, then using feature importance and marginal average analysis to reveal systemic performance disparities across different language types and resource levels.

Computing and comparing marginal average translation quality scores across 9 geographic regions to highlight systemic performance gaps, such as European languages consistently outperforming African languages in machine translation.
